data.field_of_study: atmospheric and related oceanic or hydrologic sciences (marine biology excluded)
data.other_hard: entering freshman year of college in fall 2027; plan to pursue a degree in atmospheric or related oceanic or hydrologic sciences
data.evidence_sentence: Applicants must be U.S. citizens or hold permanent resident status.
data.notes: The page says the program is open to all high school students, but the eligibility list restricts it to U.S. citizens or permanent residents; the eligibility list was used. Named scholarships are sponsored by partners under one program, so the criteria apply to the whole program. Stipend is $5000 in total, paid as $2500 per year for freshman and sophomore years; second-year funding depends on completing the first year. Encouragement to apply from women, minorities and disabled students is a preference, not a requirement. One recommendation letter is required. Host university is not named on the page.
